rules: This review does not authorize a production write or image download.
Canonical identity requires an official institution, architect or project source.
A broad skyline image is not accepted as a primary building image when the subject is ambiguous.
Officially co-authored work is not collapsed to one architect.
Graduation-linked records and protected image-fill work remain outside this batch.

evidence.claim: RSHP identifies Parc.1 as a mixed-use project in Seoul, South Korea, dated 2003-2021.
The official site places Parc.1 at 108 Yeoui-daero, Seoul.

image_review.reason: The source and inspected image depict Dangsan Railway Bridge with a distant Yeouido skyline, not an identity-safe view of Parc.1.
image_review.replacement_reason: The Commons Parc1 category warns that South Korea does not provide Commons-acceptable freedom of panorama for this architecture. Incidental skyline files cannot be promoted into a primary building image.

required_actions: Set city to Seoul and country to South Korea using the existing KR code.
Set the broad type to mixed-use after confirming the accepted type slug.
Add the RSHP project page as official source.
Keep the image replacement blocked until an architect-approved, owner-approved or otherwise safely licensed subject image is available.

evidence.claim: The World Trade Center site identifies RSHP as architect, 175 Greenwich Street as address and June 2018 as opening.

image_review.reason: The inspected image is a broad Lower Manhattan skyline view and does not make 3 World Trade Center an unambiguous subject.

replacement_candidate.review_note: The completed 3 World Trade Center is the clear primary subject; 4 World Trade Center is secondary at right.

required_actions: Set city to New York City, country to United States and broad type to office.
Add the official World Trade Center project page.
Use the reviewed JJBers Commons file as the replacement candidate after the pre-write file-page recheck.
